decision: Sam 2026-11-19 temporary functional admission decision in AGENTS.md, through Taipei end of 2026-11-26. Independent review PASS from claude-erp-app-tl-01 via agentmsg 7e786140 on test commit cebd5c774d375df527ffd6e895b31d5b41c1b58f and blob 1b62562b0c6878a586851c350ff64b6dcc2c098f.
purpose: Verify existing-order shipping for a blocked customer, immutable shipment snapshot fields, and safe rejection of stale address or contact during concurrent updates.
data: Four isolated uses of existing shipmentDraftFixture (one single-line confirmed SO, one Customer, one shipping Address, one shipping Contact each). Unchanged fixture pins are already covered by fulfillment-fixture-permission-catalogue.json.
concurrency: One test process. Two concurrent transactions for each lock-wait variant plus read-only observation on the fixture connection.
repetitions: One execution per behavior and one variant per child type.
thresholds: Shipment succeeds for blocked Customer with valid children; saved snapshot fields equal original values after master edits; real child conflicts reject with no issued details and shipment returns to Draft. Existing coverage floors unchanged.
trigger: Existing functional server integration suite. No workflow or capacity catalog changes.
cost: New file took about 6 seconds on the isolated local MySQL instance; CI impact unmeasured.

cases: TC-071 confirmed order can ship after its customer is blocked
TC-071 shipment preserves the exact original customer, address and contact fields
TC-071 shipment refuses a child version changed by a concurrent transaction
